name: Exporting
when: Making a PowerPoint, PDF or Excel copy

variants.name: Print
variants.desc: A page slides out of its side while it buzzes like a printer.

variants.name: Stamp
variants.desc: Hops up and stamps the page with a green tick.

variants.name: Paper plane
variants.desc: Throws a paper plane that glides off to the right.

variants.name: Deal slides
variants.desc: Deals three slides out into a fan.

variants.name: Box up
variants.desc: A page drops into a box, the flaps fold shut and it bounces.
